title: Sous Vide Mashed Potato
description: Creamy mashed potatoes cooked sous vide with butter, cream, milk, and seasoning, with an optional baked crust finish.
steps: Heat the water bath to 190°F (88°C). Hot tap water or the stove can be used to shorten preheating time.
Peel the potatoes and cut into 1 cm slices.
Add the potatoes to a cooking bag, then add the butter, cream, milk, salt, and optional onion powder or other seasonings.
Remove the air using a vacuum sealer or the displacement method and seal the bag.
Cook in the 190°F (88°C) water bath for about 45 minutes, or until the potatoes are tender enough to mash.
Remove the potatoes from the bag and mash to the desired consistency. For a smoother texture, use a ricer or sieve.
Serve immediately. Optionally, transfer to a casserole and bake at 350°F (177°C) for about 15 minutes to develop a crust.
Optional: add rosemary or garlic to the bag for a seasoned variation.
